## Roadmap {.title-11 .text-90 .crunch-p}

*(Logistical point: [Form](https://forms.gle/i7wnwEKTuTCEPUBw7) for new AWS Canvas accounts)*

* Week 3: **Map-Reduce** $\leadsto$ Last Week: **Athena** with **AWS Glue** under the hood for "automated" ETL!
* This Week: Hitting a wall with Athena... It **doesn't know in advance what [types of] queries you're going to make!**
* If you're going to **group by** (e.g.) **state**, then rent **50 computers** to process one state each, Athena doesn't know to **place the Ohio data on the Ohio computer!**
* **Hadoop MapReduce**: Allows **"steering"** of Map-Reduced data-computation pairing

## First Things First: OpenJDK

* **Spark 4**: Recommended JDK version = [**21**](https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/21/)^[[21?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oe6teqX2y6Y)]
  * *(How would you know this without me telling you? Truly idk)*

``` {.bash}
sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk-headless
```
